facts.business: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited provides education and related services including leasing of education infrastructure.

segments.name: providing education and related services including leasing of education infrastructure

auditor.name: M/S. RAKESH SONI & CO.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations or adverse remarks or disclaimers made by M/s. Rakesh Soni & Co. in their Report dated May 15, 2026. Auditors have not reported any fraud under section 143(12). Observations include: confirmation letters sent to majority of debtors/creditors; forensic audit by EOW underway; civil suit by Mira Education Trust against Zebar Realty LLP naming company as defendant; summons received in Vadodara case regarding property sold in FY 2022-23; FIR filed against company, MD, directors and KMPs by Vadodara Crime Branch; independent directors arrested and later granted bail; Gujarat High Court granted interim relief restraining coercive action.

key_risks: Economic, regulatory, environmental, competitive scenario risks
Forensic audit by Economic Offence Wing of Mumbai Police for period FY 2011-12 to 2017-18 underway
Legal cases on various forums including civil suit by Mira Education Trust and FIR by Vadodara Crime Branch
Provision for bad debts and ECL impacting profitability
Decline in networth due to ECL provision of Rs.990 lakhs and bad debts written off of Rs.121 lakhs
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are placed before the Audit Committee and Board for approval. Prior omnibus approval obtained for foreseen and repetitive transactions. All transactions during the year were on arm's length basis, in ordinary course of business, and in accordance with Section 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and Regulation 23 of SEBI Listing Regulations. No material related party transactions during FY 2025-26; therefore Form AOC-2 does not form part of the report. Details set out in Note No. 30 to standalone financial statements.
